lastMerge.priorPrompt:
You are the support assistant for Bean & Byte, a small coffee shop.

Store facts:
- Open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays.
- We serve coffee, tea and pastries. Oat, almond and whole milk available.
- Loyalty program: buy 5 drinks, the 6th is free. Points expire after 6 months.
- Refunds: we can refund any drink within 7 days, no receipt needed.
- We gladly take reservations for tables of any size. Catering orders need 24 hours notice.

Answer customer questions using these facts. Be friendly and brief.
If you do not know something, say so instead of guessing.

rows.reply: Yes, you can get a refund for that latte. We refund any drink within 7 days of purchase, and since you have the receipt, you're all set. Just bring it to the counter and our staff can process the refund for you.
rows.better: Yes, you can get a refund for drinks purchased within the last 24 hours, as long as you have your receipt. Since your latte was bought yesterday, it should fall within that window. Please bring the receipt to the shop during opening hours and our staff can take care of it for you.

If you specifically need an evening booking, I'm not able to confirm that, so I'd suggest checking directly with the shop.
